directive: Enemies are designed to challenge one legendary active Titan without relying on inflated health pools.
corePhilosophy: A single Titan should feel powerful, pressured, and readable at all times.
Scaling adds tactical problems before it adds raw statistics.
Campaign progression uses mostly fixed bands so old victories become proof of growth.
Repeatable and endgame content uses controlled dynamic scaling inside explicit caps.
Enemy AI fights the Titan as a mythic threat: surround, deny resources, exploit terrain, then survive the Divine swing.

enemyArchetypes.purpose: Create positional pressure and execution chains.
enemyArchetypes.counterplay: Area control, hazard baiting, cleave, execution routing.

enemyArchetypes.purpose: Force stance discipline and terrain planning.
enemyArchetypes.counterplay: Dodge charge lanes, parry windows, armor break, displacement.

enemyArchetypes.purpose: Threaten from range and punish exposed paths.
enemyArchetypes.counterplay: Line-of-sight breaks, pursuit reactions, high-ground denial.

enemyArchetypes.purpose: Restrict movement and disrupt clean objective routes.
enemyArchetypes.counterplay: Cleanse zones, destroy anchors, shift stance, terrain immunity builds.

enemyArchetypes.purpose: Attack Momentum, Divinity, cooldowns, and reactions.
enemyArchetypes.counterplay: Prioritize, interrupt casts, execute before drain resolves.

enemyArchetypes.purpose: Protect bosses, rituals, exits, and high-value threats.
Make low-health Titan states dangerous without cheap instant death.
enemyArchetypes.counterplay: Guard stance, preemptive kill, concealment, Divine Ascension reset.

enemyArchetypes.purpose: Single mechanic-focused enemy that changes how the room is solved.
enemyArchetypes.counterplay: Learn mechanic, exploit weakness, deny setup.

enemyArchetypes.purpose: Mini-boss duel embedded inside a larger battlefield.
enemyArchetypes.counterplay: Read phases, conserve Momentum, use terrain windows.

enemyArchetypes.purpose: Major boss mirror: another mythic being with its own meter and stance rules.
enemyArchetypes.counterplay: Deny their resource loop, punish stance shift, survive Ascension.

early.enemyLevelRule: fixed bands within -1/+2 of mission recommendation

late.enemyLevelRule: fixed boss bands and controlled mission modifiers
late.ai: coordinated denial of executions, Momentum, and Divinity

missionLevelTemplate.dynamicAllowance: repeatable variants may flex within +/-10% power, never beyond tier caps

bossScaling.fixedBands: story and older bosses stay in declared ranges
bossScaling.dynamicBands: endgame rematches flex inside named tier caps
bossScaling.statCapRule: never erase overleveling in campaign content
bossScaling.mechanicRule: new difficulty adds phases, hazards, AI packages, or weakness puzzles before major stat jumps

endgameScaling.eliteCampaigns: fixed tier bands with optional challenge modifiers
endgameScaling.asyncTitanChallenge: defender Titan level normalized within bracket, gear effects preserved with caps
endgameScaling.mythic: controlled scaling plus leaderboard scoring, not endless stat inflation
